speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you have a longstanding pruritic rash with numbness and tingling on your palms; to begin my assessment, how long have these symptoms been present, and do you notice any specific pattern or triggers?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT). The combination of a pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body), sensory neuropathy (tingling in palms), and risk factors (livestock farming suggesting potential iron overload or viral hepatitis exposure) is highly characteristic. Given the strong clinical picture and lack of contradictory data, no further questions or tests are required.
